name: Almhof Family Resort & SPA
beschreibung: The Almhof Family Resort & SPA is a family-oriented hotel located in Gerlos, Tyrol. It is situated close to the valley station of the Dorfbahn cable car, leading into the extensive Zillertal Arena ski domain. The resort offers spacious family rooms and apartments. The wellness area includes an indoor swimming pool, a whirlpool, and multiple saunas. For younger guests, there is an indoor play area, a petting zoo, and a supervised children's activity program. Dining is provided on a half-board basis featuring a rich breakfast buffet and dinner. A shuttle service to the ski lifts is also available. The resort perfectly balances active outdoor pursuits with dedicated relaxation.
